goal: achieved +10-15% aggregate coverage vs fixed baseline on same split
targets_note: validation 8 targets ONLY (isort, mimesis, mlxtend incl. SFS.fit, typesystem)
decision_rule: promote if candidate_mean_aggregate - baseline_mean_aggregate >= +0.10 (10 pts absolute) on same split
decision_outcome: REVISED 2026-08-16 - MEASURED with no-lever control x6 vs leverAD x6 (validation 8-target). no-lever mean 0.8754 (sd 0.018), leverAD mean 0.8336 (sd 0.090). Delta = -0.0417 (95% CI -0.115 .. +0.032). Mann-Whitney U1=24 (no separation; leverAD NOT above no-lever). SFS.fit: no-lever 0.865 vs leverAD 0.820 (both high variance). CONCLUSION: levers do NOT raise coverage; aggregate unchanged (~0.83-0.88) and leverAD adds variance without improvement. NOT promotable. +10-15% NOT achieved on validation by lever A+D.
variance_policy: SFS.fit has high cross-replicate variance (9-draw hit-rate ~44% at >=0.9); do NOT gate on every-replicate >=0.9. Gate on aggregate mean across replicates. ADDED: due to SFS variance dominating, require >=6 replicates AND compare distributions (CI), not single means.
cache_policy: use a fresh artifacts-dir per measurement to avoid cache replay (digest only hashes prompt, not target_context runtime).
